units.source_text: 他在铁锹上坐下了，开始点烟。

en.t: He sat down on the shovel and began lighting a cigarette.

units.source_text: 划到第三根火柴，总算点着了。

en.t: By the third match, he finally got it lit.

units.source_text: 像一点墨水滴进水里似的，积淀下来的疲劳，一圈圈播撒开去，

en.t: Like a drop of ink falling into water, the fatigue that had settled in him spread outward in rings,

units.source_text: 成了水母，成了带长彩条的绣球，成了原子核模型图。

en.t: becoming a jellyfish, becoming a paper ball with long colored streamers, becoming a diagram of an atomic nucleus.

units.source_text: 猫头鹰发现了田鼠，发出令人毛骨悚然的叫声招呼着同伴。

en.t: An owl had spotted a field mouse and was calling to its companions with a bloodcurdling cry.

units.source_text: 不安的狗，吐出胃肠般地狂吠着。

en.t: An uneasy dog barked wildly, as if vomiting up its own entrails.

units.source_text: 高高的夜空上，速度不一的风声相互摩擦，不停地鸣叫着。

en.t: High in the night sky, winds of differing speeds rubbed against one another and kept on howling.

units.source_text: 沙子像薄皮，被“风之刀”一层一层剥起，在大地上流动着。

en.t: The sand, like thin skin, was peeled up layer by layer by the knife of the wind and flowed over the earth.

units.source_text: 他擦去汗水，擤掉鼻涕，掸落头上的沙子。

en.t: He wiped away his sweat, blew his nose, and brushed the sand from his head.

units.source_text: 脚下的风纹，像忽然停止翻滚的浪头。

en.t: The wind ripples at his feet were like wave crests that had suddenly stopped rolling over.
